questions.q: True or false? Your wall players may rush the taker before the free kick is taken.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. The wall stays the required distance until the ball is kicked and clearly moves.
choiceExplanations: Rushing in early breaks the distance rule, so Blue takes the kick again and you can be booked.
Right, it's false. The wall stays the required distance until the ball is kicked and clearly moves.

questions.q: Blue plays the free kick short. Put your wall's jobs in order, first to last.
options: Near wall player closes the receiver
Wall player covers the outside return
questions.explain: Right. Hold the distance, wait for the ball to move, close the receiver, then cover the return.
choiceExplanations: Right. Hold the distance, wait for the ball to move, close the receiver, then cover the return.
The short pass comes after the wall is set at the required distance.
The wall can only close once the ball is kicked and clearly moves.
Covering the return is last, after the receiver carries inside and the taker runs outside.

questions.q: One wall player closes the short receiver. The other wall player is hidden. Tap where they stay.
options: Join the press on the receiver
questions.explain: Yes. One wall player presses and the other protects the crossing route, so each job stays covered.
choiceExplanations: Two wall players on one receiver leave the crossing route open for a ball into the box.
The taker has already passed, so chasing leaves the crossing route open.
Yes. One wall player presses and the other protects the crossing route, so each job stays covered.
